units.literal: The state of Bohai sent envoys to present tribute at court.

units.zh: 十二月戊辰，禁用鉛錢。
units.en: In the twelfth month, on wuchen, the use of lead coin was forbidden.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on wuchen, the use of lead coin was forbidden.

units.zh: 壬申，以中書侍郎兼兵部尚書、充樞密使韓昭裔為檢校司空、同平章事，充河中節度使。
units.en: On renshen Han Zhaoyi, Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Minister of War, and Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner, was made honorary Minister of Works, Associate Counselor, and Hezhong military commissioner.
units.literal: On renshen, Han Zhaoyi, Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of War and Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made honorary Minister of Works, Associate Counselor, and military commissioner of Hezhong.

units.zh: 甲戌，以宗正少卿李延祚為將作監致仕。
units.en: On jiaxu Li Yanzuo, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Clan, was made Director of Palace Buildings and retired from office.
units.literal: On jiaxu, Li Yanzuo, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Clan, was made Director of Palace Buildings and retired from office.

units.zh: 丁丑，故武安軍州節度使、累贈太傅劉建峰贈太尉，從湖南之請也。
units.en: On dingchou Liu Jianfeng, late Wu'an commander and repeatedly posthumously advanced to Grand Tutor, was posthumously made Grand Marshal at Hunan's request.
units.literal: On dingchou, Liu Jianfeng, late military commissioner of the Wu'an Army and repeatedly posthumously advanced to Grand Tutor, was posthumously advanced to Grand Marshal, acceding to a request from Hunan.

units.zh: 戊寅，太常奏：「來年正月一日上辛，祀昊天上帝於圓丘，依禮大祠不朝。」
units.en: On wuyin the Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "On the first shangxin day of the first month of next year, the Supreme God of the Vast Heaven will be sacrificed to at the Round Mound; according to ritual, great sacrifices preclude a court audience."
units.literal: On wuyin, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices memorialized: "On the first shangxin day of the first month of next year, the Supreme God of the Vast Heaven will be sacrificed to at the Round Mound; according to ritual, on great sacrifices there is no court audience."

units.zh: 詔曰：「祀事在質明前，儀仗在日出後，事不相妨，宜依常年受朝。」
units.en: An edict read: "The sacrifice takes place before dawn, while the ceremonial guard forms after sunrise; the two do not interfere. The annual court audience should be held as usual."
units.literal: An edict stated: "The sacrifice takes place before dawn, while the ceremonial guard forms after sunrise; the two do not interfere with each other. The annual court audience should be held as usual."

units.zh: 壬午，以翰林學士承旨、戶部侍郎程遂為兵部侍郎；
units.en: On renwu Cheng Sui, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Vice Minister of War;
units.literal: On renwu, Cheng Sui, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Vice Minister of War;

units.zh: 翰林學士、工部侍郎崔棁為戶部侍郎；
units.en: Cui Yuan, Hanlin Academician and Vice Minister of Works, was made Vice Minister of Revenue;
units.literal: Cui Yuan, Hanlin Academician and Vice Minister of Works, was made Vice Minister of Revenue;

units.zh: 翰林學士、中書舍人和凝為工部侍郎，並依前充職。
units.en: He Ning, Hanlin Academician and Secretariat Drafter, was made Vice Minister of Works—all retaining their concurrent posts as before.
units.literal: He Ning, Hanlin Academician and Secretariat Drafter, was made Vice Minister of Works—all retaining their concurrent posts as before.

units.zh: 乙酉，以前秘書監楊凝式為兵部侍郎。
units.en: On yiyou Yang Ningshi, former Director of the Palace Library, was made Vice Minister of War.
units.literal: On yiyou, Yang Ningshi, former Director of the Palace Library, was made Vice Minister of War.

units.zh: 己丑，以前同州節度使馮道為司空，以尚書右僕射劉煦為左僕射，以太子少師盧質為右僕射，以兵部侍郎馬縞兼國子祭酒。
units.en: On jichou Feng Dao, former Tong Prefecture commander, was made Minister of Works; Liu Xu, Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, was made Left Vice Director; Lu Zhi, Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent, was made Right Vice Director; Ma Gao, Vice Minister of War, was made concurrent Rector of the Directorate of Education.
units.literal: On jichou, Feng Dao, former military commissioner of Tong Prefecture, was made Minister of Works; Liu Xu, Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, was made Left Vice Director; Lu Zhi, Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent, was made Right Vice Director; Ma Gao, Vice Minister of War, was made concurrent Rector of the Directorate of Education.

units.zh: 以翰林承旨、兵部尚書、知制誥盧質為檢校司空，充同州節度使。
units.en: Lu Zhi, Hanlin edict-drafter and War minister, became acting Minister of Works and Tong commissioner.
units.literal: Hanlin edict-drafter, Minister of War, and edict drafter Lu Zhi was made acting Grand Preceptor and Tongzhou military commissioner.

units.zh: 丙戌，以韓昭裔為兵部尚書致仕，馬裔孫為太子賓客致仕，房暠為右驍衛大將軍致仕，皆唐末帝之舊臣也。
units.en: On the bingxu day, Han Zhaoyi, Ma Yisun, and Fang Gao were granted retirement as minister of war, guest of the heir apparent, and great general of the Right Xiaowei Guard—all former ministers of the last Tang emperor.
units.literal: On the bingxu day, Han Zhaoyi was granted retirement as Minister of War, Ma Yisun as Guest of the Heir Apparent, and Fang Gao as Great General of the Right Xiaowei Guard—all were former ministers of the Last Emperor of Tang.

units.zh: 壬寅，夔州節度使楊漢章移鎮雲州，以北京馬步軍都指揮使兼欽州刺史張敬達為鳳州節度使。
units.en: On renyin Yang Hanzhang moved from Kuizhou to Yun and Zhang Jingda of Beijing became Feng commissioner.
units.literal: On renyin, Kuizhou military commissioner Yang Hanzhang was transferred to Yun prefecture; Beijing horse-and-foot commander-in-chief and acting Qin prefecture military commissioner Zhang Jingda was made Feng prefecture military commissioner.

units.zh: 魏徵補註
units.en: Wei Zheng's supplementary note
units.literal: Wei Zheng's supplementary note

units.zh: 史臣侍中鄭國公魏徵考覽記書，參詳故老，云後主初即位，以始興王叔陵之亂，被傷臥于承香閣下，時諸姬嵭不得進，唯張貴妃侍焉。
units.en: The historiographer, palace attendant and Duke of Zheng, Wei Zheng, examined the records and consulted elders and wrote: When the Last Emperor first succeeded, he was wounded in the disorder of Prince of Shixing Shuling and lay ill below the Hall of Accepting Fragrance; none of the palace women could enter—only Noble Consort Zhang attended him.
units.literal: The historiographer, Palace Attendant and Duke of Zheng, Wei Zheng, examined records and consulted elders, saying: When the Last Emperor first took the throne, because of the disorder of Prince of Shixing Shuling, he was wounded and lay ill below the Hall of Accepting Fragrance; at that time none of the ladies could enter—only Noble Consort Zhang attended him.

units.zh: 甲子，都官郎中、知制誥崔棁上言，請搜訪宣宗已來野史，以備編修，從之。
units.en: On jiazi Cui Zhuang asked to gather unofficial histories since Xuanzong for compilation, and it was approved.
units.literal: On jiazi Director of Punishments, drafter of edicts Cui Zhuang memorialized asking to search for unofficial histories since Emperor Xuanzong for compilation—approved.

units.zh: 盧導，字熙化，其先范陽人也。
units.en: Lu Dao, courtesy name Xihua, came originally from Fanyang.
units.literal: Lu Dao, style name Xihua, was originally from Fanyang.

units.zh: 導少而儒雅，美詞翰，善談論。
units.en: From youth Dao was cultivated and scholarly, gifted in letters, and an engaging speaker.
units.literal: Dao from youth was refined and scholarly, excelled in letters, and was skilled in discourse.

units.zh: 導與舍人張昭遠先至，馮道請導草勸進箋，導曰：「潞王入朝，郊迎可也；
units.en: Dao and Drafter Zhang Zhaoyuan arrived first. Feng Dao asked Dao to draft a memorial urging the prince to take the throne. Dao said, "When the Prince of Lu comes to court, a suburban welcome is enough;
units.literal: Dao and Drafter Zhang Zhaoyuan arrived first. Feng Dao asked Dao to draft a memorial urging accession. Dao said: "When the Prince of Lu enters court, a suburban welcome is fitting;

units.zh: 唐天祐初，登進士第，釋褐除校書郎，由均州鄖鄉縣令、入為監察御史，三遷職方員外郎，充史館修撰，改河南縣令禮部郎中，賜紫，轉右司郎中兼侍御史知雜事。
units.en: At the start of the Tang Tianyou era he passed the jinshi examination. Upon entering service he was appointed collator, then magistrate of Yunxiang in Jun Prefecture, then investigating censor at court. After three promotions he became vice director of the Bureau of Appointments and compiler in the History Office, then magistrate of Henan and director of the Ministry of Rites, received purple robes, and became right department director while also serving as attending censor in charge of miscellaneous affairs.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianyou of Tang he passed the jinshi examination; upon doffing commoner's clothes he was made collator, then magistrate of Yunxiang in Jun Prefecture, then entered court as Investigating Censor. After three promotions he became Vice Director of the Bureau of Appointments, served as compiler in the History Office, was changed to magistrate of Henan and Director of the Ministry of Rites, was granted purple robes, and became Right Department Director concurrently Attending Censor in charge of Miscellaneous Affairs.

units.zh: 天成中，以本官征還，拜右諫議大夫。
units.en: During the Tiancheng era he was recalled to his former rank and appointed Right Remonstrance Councilor.
units.literal: In the Tiancheng era he was recalled in his former rank and appointed Right Remonstrance Councilor.

units.zh: 長興末，為中書舍人，權知貢舉。
units.en: At the end of the Changxing era he was Secretariat drafter with acting charge of the civil service examinations.
units.literal: At the end of Changxing he was Secretariat Drafter with acting charge of the civil service examinations.

units.zh: 晉天福中，由禮部侍郎遷尚書右丞，判吏部尚書銓事，秩滿，拜吏部侍郎。
units.en: During the Jin Tianfu era he rose from vice minister of rites to Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs with charge of selection affairs under the minister of personnel. When his term ended he was made vice minister of personnel.
units.literal: In the Tianfu era of Jin he was transferred from Vice Minister of Rites to Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs with concurrent administration of selection affairs under the Minister of Personnel; when his term ended he was appointed Vice Minister of Personnel.

units.zh: 祖伯卿，唐殿中侍御史。
units.en: His grandfather Boqing served as attending censor in the palace under Tang.
units.literal: His grandfather Boqing was Attending Censor in the Palace of Tang.

units.zh: 父如晦，國子監丞，贈戶部侍郎。
units.en: His father Ruhui was assistant director of the Directorate of Education and was posthumously honored as vice minister of revenue.
units.literal: His father Ruhui was Assistant Director of the Directorate of Education and was posthumously awarded Vice Minister of Revenue.

units.zh: 以病免，閑居於漢上，久之。
units.en: Illness forced his retirement, and he lived in seclusion along the Han for many years.
units.literal: He was dismissed on account of illness and lived in retirement on the Han River for a long time.

units.zh: 時軍眾離潰，人情奔駭，百官移時未有至者。
units.en: The armies were scattered in rout and the people fled in panic. For a long while no officials appeared.
units.literal: At the time the armies were scattered in rout and the people fled in panic; for a long while no officials arrived.

units.zh: 若勸進之事，安可造次。
units.en: as for urging him to take the throne, how can we do that rashly.
units.literal: as for urging accession, how can it be done rashly.

units.zh: 且潞王與主上，皆太后之子，或廢或立，當從教令，安得不稟策母後，率爾而行！」
units.en: Moreover, the prince and the emperor are both sons of the Empress Dowager. Whether one is deposed or enthroned should follow her command. How can we act without seeking her decision and proceed so recklessly!"
units.literal: Moreover, the Prince of Lu and the emperor are both sons of the Empress Dowager. Whether one is deposed or enthroned should follow her command—how can we act without seeking the Empress Dowager's decision and proceed so lightly!"

units.zh: 導曰：「今主上蒙塵在外，遽以大位勸人，若潞王守道，以忠義見責，未審何詞以對！
units.en: Dao said, "The emperor now suffers exile abroad. If we hastily offer the throne to another, and the prince holds to loyalty and rebukes us for treachery, what answer could we give?
units.literal: Dao said: "Now the emperor suffers exile abroad. If we hastily urge the throne upon another, and the Prince of Lu holds to the Way and rebukes us for disloyalty, I do not know what words we could answer with!

units.zh: 不如率群臣詣宮門，取太后進止，即去就善矣。」
units.en: Better to lead the ministers to the palace gate and obtain the Empress Dowager's decision. Then whether to go or stay will be properly settled."
units.literal: It would be better to lead the ministers to the palace gate and obtain the Empress Dowager's decision—then whether to go or stay would be well settled."

units.zh: 是日，潞王未至，馮道等止於上陽門外，又令導草勸進箋，導執之如初。
units.en: That day the prince had not yet arrived. Feng Dao and the others waited outside the Shangyang Gate and again ordered Dao to draft the accession memorial. Dao held firm as before.
units.literal: That day the Prince of Lu had not yet arrived; Feng Dao and the others stopped outside the Shangyang Gate and again ordered Dao to draft the accession memorial. Dao held to his position as before.

units.zh: 導之守正也如是。
units.en: Such was Dao's steadfast integrity.
units.literal: Such was Dao's upholding of what was right.

units.zh: 六年秋，卒於東京，時年七十六。
units.en: In the autumn of the sixth year he died in the Eastern Capital at the age of seventy-six.
units.literal: In autumn of the sixth year he died in the Eastern Capital, aged seventy-six.

units.zh: 明年春，潞王自鳳翔擁大軍赴闕，唐閔帝奔於衛州，宰相馮道、李愚集百官於天宮寺，將出迎潞王。
units.en: The following spring the Prince of Lu led a great army from Fengxiang toward the capital. Emperor Min of Tang fled to Weizhou. Chief ministers Feng Dao and Li Yu assembled the officials at Tiangong Temple, preparing to go out and welcome the prince.
units.literal: The next spring the Prince of Lu marched from Fengxiang at the head of a great army toward the capital. Tang Emperor Min fled to Weizhou. Chief ministers Feng Dao and Li Yu gathered the officials at Tiangong Temple, intending to go out and welcome the Prince of Lu.

units.zh: 馮道曰：「凡事要務實，勸進其可已乎？」
units.en: Feng Dao said, "In all affairs one must be practical. Can we stop short of urging accession?"
units.literal: Feng Dao said: "In all affairs one must be practical—can urging accession be stopped?"

units.zh: 道未及對，會京城巡檢安從進報曰：「潞王至矣，安得百僚無班。」
units.en: Before Dao could reply, capital inspector An Congjin reported, "The Prince of Lu has arrived. How can the officials stand without order."
units.literal: Before Dao could reply, Capital Inspector An Congjin reported: "The Prince of Lu has arrived—how can the officials be without formation."

units.zh: 即紛然而去。
units.en: Everyone scattered and hurried away.
units.literal: They at once scattered and left.

units.zh: 李愚曰：「舍人之言是也，吾輩信罪人矣。」
units.en: Li Yu said, "The drafter is right. We are truly guilty men."
units.literal: Li Yu said: "The drafter's words are right—we are indeed guilty men."

units.zh: 己巳，秘書少監姚顗為左散騎常侍，以太子左諭德陸崇為右散騎常侍，以兵部郎中蕭希甫為左諫議大夫，前幽州節度判官呂夢奇為右諫議大夫，以鄴都副留守孫嶽為潁州團練使。
units.en: On jisi Yao Hui became Left Regular Attendant; crown prince mentor Lu Chong became Right Regular Attendant; Xiao Xifu of Military Affairs became Left Remonstrator; Lü Mengqi, former Youzhou aide, became Right Remonstrator; Sun Yue, Yedu deputy regent, became Ying training commissioner.
units.literal: On jisi, Vice Director of the Secretariat Yao Hui was made Left Regular Attendant; the crown prince's Left Mentor Lu Chong was made Right Regular Attendant; Bureau of Military Affairs director Xiao Xifu was made Left Remonstrator; former Youzhou military commissioner's aide Lü Mengqi was made Right Remonstrator; Yedu deputy regent Sun Yue was made Yingzhou training commissioner.

units.zh: 庚寅，以客省使李嚴領泗州防禦使，以河中節度副使李鈴為太子賓客。
units.en: On gengyin Li Yan of Guest Reception became Si defense commissioner and Li Ling of Hezhong became crown prince mentor.
units.literal: On gengyin Guest Reception commissioner Li Yan was made acting Si defense commissioner; Heyang military vice commissioner Li Ling was made crown prince mentor.

units.zh: 六月，北面招收指揮使安重榮以部曲數千人入城。
units.en: In the sixth month, northern recruitment commander An Chongrong entered the city with several thousand men of his personal following.
units.literal: In the sixth month, northern recruitment commander An Chongrong entered the city with several thousand men of his personal following.

units.zh: 李專美，字翊商，京兆萬年人也。
units.en: Li Zhuanmei, whose courtesy name was Yishang, came from Wannian in Jingzhao.
units.literal: Li Zhuanmei, courtesy name Yishang, was a man of Wannian in Jingzhao.

units.zh: 專美少篤學文，以父樞唐昭宗時常應進士舉，為覆試所落，不許再入，專美心愧之，由是不遊文場。
units.en: Zhuanmei from youth was devoted to scholarship and letters. His father Shu had once taken the presented-scholar examination under Emperor Zhaozong of Tang but was failed in the repeat examination and barred from re-entry; ashamed on his father's account, Zhuanmei never entered the examination arena himself.
units.literal: Zhuanmei from youth was devoted to learning and literature; because his father Shu in the time of Emperor Zhaozong of Tang had once entered the presented-scholar examination and was failed in the repeat examination and not permitted to enter again, Zhuanmei felt ashamed in his heart and on this account did not enter the literary arena.

units.zh: 偽梁貞明中，河南尹張全義以專美名族之後，奏為陸渾尉，秩滿，改舞陽令。
units.en: During the Zhenming era of the Liang, Zhang Quanyi, Governor of Henan, because Zhuanmei came from a distinguished clan, had him appointed sheriff of Luhun; when his term ended he was made magistrate of Wuyang.
units.literal: In the Zhenming era of the false Liang, Zhang Quanyi, Governor of Henan, because Zhuanmei was descended from a famous clan, memorialized the throne to appoint him sheriff of Luhun; when his term expired he was changed to magistrate of Wuyang.

units.zh: 末帝即位，除尚書庫部郎中，賜金紫，充樞密院直學士。
units.en: When the Last Emperor took the throne, Zhuanmei was appointed Director in the Bureau of Storehouses, granted the gold seal and purple robe, and made direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
units.literal: When the Last Emperor ascended the throne, Zhuanmei was appointed Director in the Bureau of Storehouses under the Ministry of Works, granted the gold seal and purple robe, and made direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

units.zh: 尋轉給事中，明年，遷兵部侍郎、端明殿學士，未幾，改檢校尚書右僕射、守秘書監，充宣徽北院使。
units.en: Soon he was made Supervising Secretary; the next year he was promoted to Vice Minister of War and academician of the Hall of Brilliant Governance; before long he was made acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, acting Director of the Imperial Library, and Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat.
units.literal: Soon he was transferred to Supervising Secretary; the next year he was promoted to Vice Minister of War and academician of the Hall of Brilliant Governance; before long he was changed to acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, acting Director of the Imperial Library, and Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat.

units.zh: 末帝留守長安，奏為從事，及移鎮鳳翔，遷為記室。
units.en: When the Last Emperor served as regent at Chang'an, he had Zhuanmei appointed as staff officer; when he was transferred to Fengxiang, Zhuanmei was promoted to recorder.
units.literal: When the Last Emperor was regent at Chang'an, he memorialized the throne to appoint Zhuanmei as staff officer; when he was transferred to command Fengxiang, Zhuanmei was promoted to recorder.

units.zh: 會專美宿於禁中，末帝召而讓之曰：「卿士人子弟，常言有才術，今致我至此，不能度運以濟時事，留才術何施也！」
units.en: Once when Zhuanmei was staying in the palace, the Last Emperor summoned and rebuked him: "You are the son of a scholar-official family and always claim talent and ability—yet you have brought me to this pass and cannot read the times to rescue the situation. What good is talent left unused?"
units.literal: Once when Zhuanmei was lodging in the palace precincts, the Last Emperor summoned and reproached him, saying: "You are the son of a scholar-official family and always speak of having talent and skill; yet you have brought me to this pass and cannot gauge the times to rescue current affairs—of what use is talent and skill left behind!"

units.zh: 專美性廉謹，大著政聲。
units.en: Zhuanmei was by nature incorrupt and cautious, and his administrative reputation was excellent.
units.literal: Zhuanmei's nature was incorrupt and cautious, and he won great renown for his governance.

units.zh: 後唐天成中，安邑榷鹽使李肅辟為推官，時唐末帝鎮河中，見其敦雅，心重之。
units.en: In the Tiancheng era of Later Tang, Li Su, commissioner for the salt monopoly at Anyi, recruited him as investigating officer. The Last Emperor of Tang was then military governor of Hezhong; seeing Zhuanmei's earnest refinement, he came to esteem him highly.
units.literal: In the Tiancheng era of Later Tang, Li Su, commissioner for the salt monopoly at Anyi, recruited him as investigating officer; at that time the Last Emperor of Tang was military governor of Hezhong, saw his earnest refinement, and valued him in his heart.

units.zh: 高祖入洛，以例除名。
units.en: When Gaozu entered Luoyang, Zhuanmei was removed from office according to precedent.
units.literal: When Gaozu entered Luoyang, Zhuanmei was removed from office according to precedent.

units.zh: 三年，復授衛尉少卿，繼遷鴻臚、大理卿。
units.en: In the third year he was again appointed Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Insignia and was subsequently promoted to Director of the Court of State Ceremonial and Director of the Court of Judicial Review.
units.literal: In the third year he was again appointed Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Insignia; he was subsequently promoted to Director of the Court of State Ceremonial and Director of the Court of Judicial Review.

units.zh: 及其行賞，雖不愜於軍士，然洛陽戶民獲免鞭笞之苦，由專美之敷揚也。
units.en: When rewards were distributed the soldiers were dissatisfied, but the households of Luoyang were spared the lash—thanks to Zhuanmei's advocacy.
units.literal: When rewards were distributed, although the soldiers were not satisfied, the households of Luoyang were spared the pain of the whip and cudgel—this was due to Zhuanmei's exposition and advocacy.

units.zh: 開運中，以病卒，時年六十二。
units.en: During the Kaiyun era he died of illness at the age of sixty-two.
units.literal: In the Kaiyun era he died of illness at age sixty-two.

units.zh: 坐客都無對者，專美屏人謂曰：「將來必為嗣主。」
units.en: None of the guests could answer. Zhuanmei drew him aside and said: "You will surely become the heir sovereign."
units.literal: None of the guests present had any reply; Zhuanmei, drawing him aside from others, said: "In the future you will certainly become the heir sovereign."

units.zh: 專美惶恐待罪，良久奏曰：「臣才力駑劣，屬當興運，陛下猥垂錄任，無以裨益聖朝，然府藏空竭，軍賞不給，非臣之罪也。
units.en: Zhuanmei, trembling with fear, waited a long while and then replied: "Your servant's abilities are mean, and though I have had the honor of serving in a time of rising fortune, I have been unable to benefit the court. Yet the treasury is empty and army rewards cannot be paid—this is not my fault.
units.literal: Zhuanmei, in fear and trembling awaiting punishment, after a long while submitted: "Your servant's talent and strength are mean and inferior; I happened to meet a time of rising fortune, and Your Majesty condescended to employ me, yet I have been unable to benefit the sagely court. Nevertheless, the treasury is empty and exhausted and army rewards cannot be supplied—this is not your servant's fault.

units.zh: 臣思明宗棄代之際，是時府庫濫賞已竭，繼以鄂王臨朝，紀綱大壞，縱有無限之財賦，不能滿驕軍溪壑之心，所以陛下孤立岐陽而得天下。
units.en: Consider Mingzong's death: the treasury had already been drained by reckless rewards. Then the Prince of E held court and discipline collapsed utterly. Even limitless wealth could not have satisfied the insatiable armies. That is why Your Majesty, standing alone at Qiyang, was able to win the realm.
units.literal: Your servant reflects that at the time when Mingzong passed from the throne, the treasury had already been drained by indiscriminate rewards; this was followed by the Prince of E's holding court, when statutes and discipline were greatly ruined; even if there had been limitless wealth and revenue, it could not have filled the insatiable hearts of the arrogant armies. That is why Your Majesty, isolated at Qiyang, was able to gain the realm.

units.zh: 臣以為國之存亡，不專在行賞，須刑政立於上，恥格行於下，賞當功，罰當罪，則近於理道也。
units.en: I believe a state's survival does not depend on rewards alone. Punishment and government must be established above, and the sense of shame must operate below; rewards must match merit and punishments must match crimes—then one approaches the way of good governance.
units.literal: Your servant considers that whether a state survives or perishes does not depend solely on dispensing rewards; punishments and government must be established above, and the sense of shame must operate below; rewards must match merit and punishments must match crimes—then one approaches the way of reason.

units.zh: 若陛下不改覆車之轍，以賞無賴之軍，徒困蒸民，存亡未可知也。
units.en: If Your Majesty does not turn from the path that overturned the cart and keeps rewarding unruly troops, you will only exhaust the people, and whether the state survives is uncertain.
units.literal: If Your Majesty does not change the track of the overturned cart and uses rewards to satisfy unruly armies, you will only weary the common people, and whether the state survives or perishes cannot be known.

units.zh: 今宜取見在財賦以給之，不必踐前言而希茍悅。」
units.en: You should pay them from wealth and revenue actually on hand, and need not fulfill your earlier promises merely to win momentary favor."
units.literal: Now you should take the wealth and revenue presently available to supply them; you need not fulfill earlier words in hope of momentary favor."

units.zh: 末帝一日曾召肅宴於衙署，專美亦預坐，末帝謂肅曰：「某夜來夢主上召去，與宋王同剃卻頭，何也？」
units.en: One day the Last Emperor summoned Su to a banquet at headquarters; Zhuanmei was also present. The Last Emperor said to Su: "Last night I dreamed that the sovereign summoned me and that the Prince of Song and I had our heads shaved together—what can this mean?"
units.literal: One day the Last Emperor summoned Su to a banquet at the government office; Zhuanmei also took a seat. The Last Emperor said to Su: "Last night I dreamed that the sovereign summoned me away and that the Prince of Song and I had our heads shaved together—what does this mean?"

units.zh: 末帝然之。
units.en: The Last Emperor agreed.
units.literal: The Last Emperor approved of this.

units.zh: 洎至洛陽，閱內庫金帛不過二三萬，尋又配率京城戶民，雖行捶楚，亦所獲無幾，末帝憂之。
units.en: When he reached Luoyang and inspected the inner treasury, he found no more than twenty or thirty thousand in gold and silk. He then levied assessments on the capital's households, but even with beatings the yield was meager, and the Last Emperor was deeply troubled.
units.literal: When he reached Luoyang and examined the inner treasury, gold and silk amounted to no more than twenty or thirty thousand; soon he also levied assessments on the households of the capital, and even though beating was applied, what was obtained was very little, and the Last Emperor was troubled.

units.zh: 以給事中張鵬為御史中丞，以御史中丞龍敏為兵部侍郎，以太僕少卿竇維為大理卿。
units.en: Zhang Peng, Supervising Secretary, was made Vice Censor-in-Chief; Long Min, Vice Censor-in-Chief, Vice Minister of War; and Dou Wei, Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud, Director of the Court of Judicial Review.
units.literal: Supervising Secretary Zhang Peng was made Vice Censor-in-Chief; Vice Censor-in-Chief Long Min was made Vice Minister of War; Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud Dou Wei was made Director of the Court of Judicial Review.

units.zh: 戊申，以前雄武軍節度使劉仲殷為右衛上將軍，邢州節度使趙鳳加爵邑。
units.en: On wushen Liu Zhongyin, former commissioner of the Xiongwu Army, was made General of the Right Guard; Zhao Feng, commissioner of Xingzhou, received additional noble rank and fief.
units.literal: On wushen former Xiongwu Army military commissioner Liu Zhongyin was made General of the Right Guard; Xingzhou military commissioner Zhao Feng was advanced in noble rank and fief.

units.zh: 丙子，以隨駕參謀耿瑗為司天監。
units.en: On bingzi staff officer Geng Yuan became Director of Astronomy.
units.literal: On bingzi Geng Yuan, staff officer with the imperial train, was made Director of Astronomy.

units.zh: 癸丑，以吳越國馬步統軍使、檢校太傅錢元球為檢校太尉、守侍中，充靜海軍節度使。
units.en: On guichou Qian Yuanqiu of Wuyue—horse-and-foot overall commander and acting Grand Tutor—became acting Grand Preceptor, palace attendant, and Jinghai commissioner.
units.literal: On guichou, Wuyue state horse-and-foot overall commander and acting Grand Tutor Qian Yuanqiu was made acting Grand Preceptor, Palace Attendant, and Jinghai army military commissioner.

units.zh: 丙戌，涇州節度使李從昶移鎮華州，以冀州刺史李金全為涇州節度使。
units.en: On bingxu Li Congchang of Jing moved to Hua and Li Jinquan of Ji became Jing commissioner.
units.literal: On bingxu, Jing military commissioner Li Congchang was transferred to Hua; Jizhou prefect Li Jinquan was made Jing military commissioner.

units.zh: 癸卯，以華清宮使李頃為右領軍衛上將軍。
units.en: On the guimao day, Li Qing, commissioner of the Huaqing Palace, was appointed general-in-chief of the Right Leading Army Guard.
units.literal: On the guimao day, Li Qing, Commissioner of the Huaqing Palace, was appointed General-in-Chief of the Right Leading Army Guard.
